summary: Continued from a prior compaction already mid-DLSS-NR work. Closed out and shipped three separate pieces: (1) feat/dlssnr-upscale-method-toggle (SGSR1 edge threshold retuned to 0.3 default from user's own in-game finding) -> PR #9 -> v0.1.1. (2) feat/dlssnr-sgsr1-vulkan (Vulkan port of the SGSR1 reduced-resolution enlarge pass, code-complete and build-verified but explicitly NOT in-game verified on Vulkan) -> PR #10 -> v0.1.2, shipped untested per user's explicit choice, release notes disclosed the gap. (3) docs/readme-housekeeping (wrong-fork links, missing wilsjo2 attribution) -> PR #11, merged. Then diagnosed and fixed a genuinely new bug: vertical-line artifacts under Apply-before-SR + reduced model resolution. Four fix attempts before finding the real cause -- three rounds smoothing the resolve's gSource/gModel enlarge read (tap spacing, then a real gModelWorkScale-vs-actual-buffer-size bug) all produced zero visible change, confirmed via a diagnostic log that the code was genuinely executing. Root cause turned out to be Replace mode's NeutwoDecode/HybridDecode having no highlight guard at all by design, diverging near white; fixed by reapplying the existing Highlight-guard/gMaxRatio clamp to Replace's result, confirmed removing the artifact on the user's own hardware (Dawnwalker). Also found and fixed (then reverted at user's request, keeping scope to the guard alone) a real white-point/exposure bug: 'Game exposure' source silently fell back to static paper-white for games supplying DLSS.Pre.Exposure without an ExposureTexture. Shipped as PR #12 (2 commits -- the fix, then 3 real bugs caught by the project's own code-review skill: a degenerate near-black decode the guard's multiplicative rescale couldn't pull back up, the guard running before detail injection could widen past it, a stale menu tooltip) -> v0.1.3. Then, per direct user request, created a new AI-OS skill (EP-4, core.ux-review.sk / UX_REVIEW) distilling universal UI/UX heuristics filtered to this project's actual surface (the ImGui overlay), after first surfacing and ruling out a narrower reading (EVOLVE_BENCHMARK, explicitly scoped to the framework's own dev repo, not this installed project). Ran MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE to close this out: archived 2 fully-closed task files (feat_dlssnr-upscale-method-toggle, fix_dlssnr-presr-reduced-res-aliasing -- sgsr1-vulkan's task file left open, still genuinely awaiting in-game verification), confirmed via  that several years-old still-open-looking status notes in the rolling main.md task file (PR #2 jitter-cancel, PR #5 hybrid re-port, PR #6 AC1+CSP) are actually long since merged and stale; deeper promotion of main.md's older technical backlog (the DLSS-NR jitter investigation) deliberately deferred rather than rushed under time pressure -- left as-is per the framework's own 'don't force a promotion' rule.
next_up: feat_dlssnr-sgsr1-vulkan task file still open pending real in-game Vulkan verification. main.md's older backlog (jitter investigation, AC1+CSP/PR#2/PR#5 status lines now confirmed stale) still needs a proper drain pass -- next MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE should verify the jitter finding against current DlssNr_DeferredSr.inl content (it now has jitter-related code that didn't exist when the original note was written) before promoting or discarding it, and strip the now-confirmed-stale PR status lines. neural-manhwa-restyle epic (memory/plans/2026-09-09-neural-manhwa-restyle.md) still approved, not started. feat_dlssnr-detail-transfer and dlss-neural-rendering branch task files untouched this session, not reviewed.
